## How Do You See Every Automation Run in Taskade?


The **All Runs** tab shows every automation run in your workspace in one list, newest first. Scheduled runs, triggered runs, and runs you started by hand all land in the same place. Open any run and you see exactly what happened, when it ran, and what each step did. The history stays saved in your Workspace DNA.


Three things change once every run is visible:


What you get What it means for you


**Every run** One list across every automation, scheduled, triggered, or started by hand


**Step by step** Open a run to see how each step went, with its input and output


**Safe to change** See the connections live, then modify, duplicate, or expand the automation


You step in only when a run needs you. Filter by status to find the failed or retried runs, open the one that stopped, and fix the step.[Learn: Automations Execution](https://www.taskade.com/learn/automation/automations-execution) walks through the **All Runs** tab and the **Runs** tab inside each automation.[Learn: Automation Triggers](https://www.taskade.com/learn/automation/triggers) covers what can start a run in the first place.

## How Does a Client Booking Turn Into Finished Work?


A client books a job and Taskade does the rest. The booking creates the job with the client's details, assigns it to a teammate, tells your team, and keeps the workflow moving. You build the booking app once, and the[automations](https://www.taskade.com/automate) carry every booking after it.


Here is the loop, one booking at a time:


```text
booking.to.done
▸ A booking comes in      → the job is created with the client's details
▸ A teammate is on it     → the job lands already assigned, no chasing
▸ Your team gets details  → sent from your connected email account
▸ Every morning, a list   → today's jobs and unpaid invoices, in your inbox


```


Each line is a building block you already have. A[form trigger](https://www.taskade.com/learn/automation/forms-trigger) catches the booking. An[assign step](https://www.taskade.com/learn/automation/assign-task) hands the job to a teammate. The[Gmail integration](https://www.taskade.com/learn/connect/gmail-integration) sends the brief from your own address. A[scheduled automation](https://www.taskade.com/learn/automation/schedule) builds the morning list. Gmail and the other premium integrations run on paid plans.


Customers, jobs, invoices, and team, in one app. The same pattern powers internal tools, client portals, and anything else where one event starts a chain of work. Start from a ready-made automation in the[automation gallery](https://www.taskade.com/automate) , or describe the chain to Taskade EVE at[/create](https://www.taskade.com/create?entry_kind=content&source=blog&entry=%2Fblog%2Fwatch-it-run) .

## What Is Workspace DNA?


Workspace DNA is the loop that keeps your apps alive. Projects remember, agents think, and automations act. Every run writes its result back to the workspace, so the next run starts from what the last one produced.[Learn: Workspace DNA](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/workspace-dna) explains how the parts feed each other.


Start with an idea, a task, or a flow. Taskade Genesis builds the system behind it, connected to 100+ integrations and frontier models from top AI labs.

## Frequently Asked Questions


How do I see what my Taskade automations did?


Open **Automations** in your workspace sidebar, then the **All Runs** tab. It lists every run, newest first, and each run opens to its steps. See[Learn: Automations Execution](https://www.taskade.com/learn/automation/automations-execution) .


Can I see why an automation run failed?


Yes. Filter the **All Runs** tab by status, open the failed run, and find the step that stopped. Each step shows its input and output.


Is it safe to change an automation that is already running?


Yes. Modify it, duplicate it to test a variation, or expand it. The run history stays, so you can compare runs before and after.


Can a client booking start the work automatically?


Yes. A[form trigger](https://www.taskade.com/learn/automation/forms-trigger) creates and assigns the job, and a[scheduled automation](https://www.taskade.com/learn/automation/schedule) sends the morning list.


What is an App Kit?


A live Taskade Genesis app you can clone with its projects, agents, and automations connected. Browse them in the[Community Gallery](https://www.taskade.com/apps) .


Can I publish my own App Kits?


Yes. Choose **Share as kit** in the Publish menu and pick **Free** or **Paid** . See[Learn: Sell App Kits](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/sell-app-kits) .


What else shipped in this update?


Build steps from Taskade EVE, agent teams that travel with a shared app, five new languages, files in agent chat, and new[desktop and mobile apps](https://www.taskade.com/downloads) .


What is Workspace DNA?


The loop behind every app: projects remember, agents reason, and automations run. See[Learn: Workspace DNA](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/workspace-dna) .
